title: refactor(providers)!: retire the DataSourceProvider, MetadataProvider and ThemeProvider trio and fix the guides that taught them (objectui#13453, part 2)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D4nNtkcxk6i4sCKHsvYsQgG)_

Part of #13453
Clause-②: no (nothing added a consumer or author can target)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读(草稿)

- **改了什么:** `@object-ui/providers` 删掉三个和别的包重名的 Provider:`DataSourceProvider`、`MetadataProvider`、`ThemeProvider`(连同 `useDataSource` / `useMetadata` / `useTheme` 和四个类型)。包里只留上传用的 `UploadProvider` / `useUpload`。同时改好引用它们的地方:byo 示例、README 和架构文档、贡献者技能指南里的一句话、对外发布的 `skills/objectui` 两篇指南。另外把 #13506 已改成私有的 runner 从这几篇指南里拿掉。
- **为什么改:** 这三个名字在 `@object-ui/react`(数据源、主题)和 `@object-ui/app-shell`(元数据)里都有同名但实现不同的版本,console 用的都是那两个包的。providers 这份在三个仓里没有任何代码引用,只出现在文档和一个示例里,AI 和开发者照着文档写,很容易引错包。
- **风险与代价(含回滚):** 对 npm 上的外部使用者是破坏性删除。按版本政策只声明 `minor`,changeset 里写明删了哪些名字,并给出迁移路径。cloud 和外部 npm 依赖方没有测量到。回滚就是 revert 这一个 PR,没有数据或接口协议上的影响。
- **席位意见:**
- **你要做的:** 审阅后在本 PR 点 Approve(os-zhuang 或 hotlong 任一人即可),之后由席位落地。

## What this removes

Second of the two PRs the claim amendment (comment 6393918010) cuts on the governed line; PR 1 (#13506, Tier S) merged at `0063f22`. This one is Tier H because it edits `.claude/skills/objectui-contributor/guides/console-development.md` and `skills/objectui/**`.

**1. The providers trio.** `packages/providers/src/{DataSourceProvider,MetadataProvider,ThemeProvider}.tsx`, `types.ts`, and their two tests (`spec-symbol-batch7.test.ts`, `theme-mode-spec-parity.test.tsx`) are deleted. The barrel keeps only the upload surface (`UploadProvider`, `useUpload`, the upload adapters), with a note on what retired and where each replacement lives. Removed names: `DataSourceProvider`, `useDataSource`, `MetadataProvider`, `useMetadata`, `ThemeProvider`, `useTheme`, and the types `DataSourceProviderProps`, `MetadataProviderProps`, `ThemePreferenceProviderProps`, `ThemePreference`.

Premise correction carried from the claim: `@object-ui/react` does not export `DataSourceProvider`, `useDataSource` or `MetadataProvider`. The replacements are:

| Retired (`@object-ui/providers`) | Use instead |
|---|---|
| `DataSourceProvider` / `useDataSource` | `SchemaRendererProvider` (`dataSource` prop), `@object-ui/react` |
| `ThemeProvider` / `useTheme` | `ThemeProvider` / `useTheme`, `@object-ui/react` (`defaultMode`; the old `system` is `auto`; `persist` keeps the choice in `localStorage`) |
| `MetadataProvider` / `useMetadata` | `MetadataProvider` / `useMetadata`, `@object-ui/app-shell` |

**2. The one code consumer, the byo example.** `examples/byo-backend-console/src/App.tsx` now wraps in `ThemeProvider defaultMode="light" persist storageKey=…` and `SchemaRendererProvider` from `@object-ui/react`; its `@object-ui/providers` dependency and the lockfile entry go. Its README follows.

**3. Docs and exemptions that named the trio.** `README.md`, `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md` (its compiled snippets now import the replacements), `examples/README.md`, `packages/providers/README.md`, the `types/src/theme.ts` comments, and two test comments that pointed at the deleted files: `p2-spec-exports.test.ts`, and the `KNOWN_COLLISIONS` note in `one-authority-per-exported-name-6273.test.ts` (no entry changes; it now records that react's `ThemeProvider` is the only one left). `docs/audits/2901-spec-enum-renderer-coverage.md` unlinks the deleted `ThemeProvider.tsx` path (read by `check-doc-links`).

**4. Governed text.**
- `.claude/skills/objectui-contributor/guides/console-development.md`: the paragraph that called `MetadataProvider` "the one name with two hits" now says the app-shell one is the only one left (`check-skills-paths` reads the deleted path).
- `skills/objectui/guides/project-setup.md`: the provider section and the decision matrix teach `SchemaRendererProvider` / `ThemeProvider` (react), `MetadataProvider` (app-shell) and `UploadProvider` (providers); the `@object-ui/runner` section becomes "use `objectui dev`", since #13506 made runner a private workspace app.
- `skills/objectui/guides/architecture.md`: the integration-package bullets follow the same split and drop runner.
- `skills/objectui/README.md`: runner leaves the Integration package list.
